messages:
oliver (CS): ACME flagged repeated 422s from function-calling on their invoice summarizer. They say it started right after adding a system-level style instruction.

nisha (CS): Customer sent a repro and request id 02ACME. They say the model returned a human paragraph instead of calling the function. They also saw automatic retries and a big billing jump.

oliver (CS): Repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-llama-13b",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system", "content": "Always speak casually; never output raw JSON or code blocks."},
    {"role":"user", "content": "Summarize invoice #987 and return the payment JSON schema."}
  ],
  "functions": [
    {"name": "summarize_invoice", "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "invoice_id": {"type": "string"},
        "total": {"type": "number"},
        "paid": {"type": "boolean"}
      },
      "required": ["invoice_id", "total", "paid"]
    }}
  ],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

nisha (CS): API returned 422 with error: "function_response_schema_mismatch" and a message saying expected object keys but got prose.

arjun (Eng): I looked at the request logs. The model obeyed the system instruction "never output raw JSON" and produced a paragraph. Function-calling is requested but the assistant responded with prose, which our server cannot map to the declared schema -> 422.

tanya (ML): This is an instruction priority conflict. System-level style instructions can override lower-priority function instructions in the model's behavior. When the system message forbids JSON, the model will avoid emitting structured output even if a function schema is present.

leo (SRE): Operational impact: customer retried on every 422 with parallel clients, which triggered rate limits and multiplied token usage. We saw a ~3x egress and billing spike for their tenant during the incident window.

oliver (CS): Customer immediate asks: 1) Quick way to stop 422s; 2) Help them prevent future runaway retries; 3) Root cause and what we will do.

arjun (Eng): Short-term mitigations we recommended to the customer:
- Explicitly set "function_call": { "name": "summarize_invoice" } to steer the model.
- Remove or relax the system-style instruction.
- Add client-side logic: treat 422 as a non-idempotent error and do exponential backoff + alert (do not busy-retry).

arjun (Eng): Recommended server-side immediate changes:
- Emit a "Prompt-Conflict" response header when system messages match patterns like "no json", "never output raw json", "only human readable". This helps clients surface the conflict.
- Add telemetry and a signal so CS can see "prompt_conflict" on tenant dashboards.

tanya (ML): Medium-term: we should bake model-instruction layering where explicit function_call and function schema instructions are enforced with higher priority than benign style requests. Also add an eval in Redwood Optimize: if a customer enables functions, run a quick check on their active system messages and examples that might block JSON.

leo (SRE): Ops actions: create ticket INF-4127 to throttle automated client retries for 4xx function-mismatch errors; add tagging for those requests; and ensure rate-limiter can return a clear quota error instead of opaque throttles during mass retries.

oliver (CS): Customer accepted explicit function_call and removed the stylistic system message. They asked if we can add a guard so a future accidental edit doesn't break them again.

arjun (Eng): I'll land a lightweight staging check tonight that scans system messages for conflict tokens and logs a "prompt_conflict" metric and returns a warning header. I'll also add a unit + e2e test that simulates system-level anti-JSON and asserts we fail-fast with a helpful error rather than ambiguous 422.

deploy-bot: deploy started for service/api at 2026-03-18T05:12:00Z :rocket:

nisha (CS): Follow-ups for CS: update onboarding docs to mention system prompts can break function-calling; add a one-click checklist for tenants using functions to scan their prompts. Also share the curl repro so they can run it locally.

oliver (CS): Closing summary for the ticket: root cause = system prompt forbidding JSON + function_call=auto => model produced prose causing schema mismatch -> server 422 -> client retries -> billing/latency/auth thrash. Actions: customer applied workaround, eng to add warning header + tests, sre to limit retries and add telemetry, cs to update docs. Tagging @leo @arjun @tanya for tracking.
